bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
tag="create-videobot:gallery-flow-034fa01"
id="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$tag")"
ids="$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$ids" | grep -c .)" -eq 1 || exit 41
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$ids")" = "$id" || exit 42
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$ids")" = true || exit 43
docker run --rm --network none --pull never --read-only --entrypoint node "$tag" --input-type=module -e 'import {creatorEditorPanel,openCreatorEditor,editCreatorDraft} from "./src/telegram/creatorUi.mjs";let d=openCreatorEditor({sellerId:"33"});if(!creatorEditorPanel(d,1,"await_video").text.includes("タイトルと動画を投稿してください"))process.exit(71);d=editCreatorDraft(d,{type:"captionTitle",text:"題名"});d=editCreatorDraft(d,{type:"paidVideo",media:{fileId:"abc_123"}});let q=creatorEditorPanel(d,2,"description");if(q.reply_markup.inline_keyboard[0][0].callback_data!=="entry:skip|r2")process.exit(72);let k=creatorEditorPanel(d,3,"editor");if(k.entities?.length!==2||k.reply_markup.inline_keyboard[2][0].text!=="✅ 登録")process.exit(73);console.log("CREATOR_PRODUCTION_UI_FLOW=PASS")'
echo VIDEO_GALLERY_DEPLOY_INDEPENDENT=PASS
echo POLLER_COUNT=1
